ein.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) in format XX-XXXXXXX

businessType.description:
Type of business entity.

trust, public-corporation, private-corporation, partnership, unincorporated-nonprofit, incorporated-nonprofit
Defaults to "llc" if not provided.

averageMonthlyIncome.description:
Average monthly income range for ACH fund disbursements.
            
Accepted formats:
- Valid Moov enum values: under-10k, 10k-50k, 50k-100k, 100k-250k, 250k-500k, 500k-1m, 1m-5m, over-5m
- Numeric values (will be auto-transformed): "50000" → "50k-100k", "100000" → "100k-250k"
- K/M suffixes: "50K", "1M"
            
Note: The backend will automatically transform numeric values to the appropriate Moov enum range.
For $50,000 monthly volume, use "50k-100k" or "50000" (both are accepted).

maximumTransactionAmount.description:
Maximum transaction amount in cents for ACH fund disbursements.
Example: "500000" for $5,000.00

averageTransactionAmount.description:
